## Motivation

Mamba radix checkpoints donate a GPU slot for every matched prefix. On a Kimi-K3 c=48 recipe that floor is `max_running_requests * 5` (480), so the GPU mamba pool stays large even when the checkpoint only needs to be reloaded from host.

## Modifications

Set `SGLANG_OPT_MAMBA_HOST_ONLY_CHECKPOINT=1` (default off). It requires `--enable-hierarchical-cache` and rejects `--enable-int8-mamba-checkpoint`. This is an environment variable, not a server argument.

With the variable unset, the server keeps the previous path: the same mamba ratio, the same donated GPU slot, the KDA ReplaySSM ring indexed by the mamba slot, a single in-flight load-back receipt, and a device match that follows GPU mamba slots. The new `InsertParams.allow_missing_mamba` bit stays false, so an insert that omits mamba still panics.

With the variable set:

- A finished request copies its flushed state into the hicache host pool and does not keep or donate a GPU slot.
- The mamba ratio drops to the live request plus the ping-pong tracking slots the extra-buffer kernel still writes. With extra buffer and overlap that is 3 (1 active + 2 ping-pong), so a 96-wide decode pool is 288 slots. `no_buffer` with page size 1 returns 1.
- The KDA ReplaySSM ring covers live requests (`max_running_requests // attn_dp + 1`) instead of every mamba slot. Padding rows are -1.
- The Rust insert accepts `mamba_host_value` without a donated `mamba_value`. A repeat insert that already found a checkpoint may omit both values; that permission is on the insert params and applies only to that insert.
- Under HiCache, a host checkpoint still counts as a device-prefix match, so the Full KV indices in front of it stay reachable. Load-back copies into the request slot and leaves the node on the host tier.

## Memory

Per-rank GPU, MI355, Kimi-K3 c=48, 96 running requests, page size 32, extra buffer, overlap, DCP 8, ReplaySSM on. The env-on pool is the size the ratio allows; `max-mamba-cache-size` has to be lowered with it. Leaving the pool at 480 keeps the 13 GB allocation and only raises the running-request cap.

| | Env off | Env on |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Mamba conv + ssm | 13.00 GB (480 slots, ratio 5) | 7.81 GB (288 slots, ratio 3) |
| KDA ReplaySSM ring | 9.14 GB (one row per mamba slot) | 1.84 GB (97 rows, one per live request) |

Env off is the earlier 0.87 log: conv 0.85 GB + ssm 12.15 GB, ring 9.14 GB. Env on conv + ssm is `ci355_ix_20261015_213315_c20e` (`max-mamba-cache-size 288`): conv 0.51 GB + ssm 7.30 GB. The same class of boot with `request_ring=True` keeps that 7.81 GB pool and sizes the ring at 97 rows (d = k = rawv = rawk = 0.306 GB, g = 0.613 GB, beta = 0.005 GB). The intermediate conv window stays 0.86 GB in both measurements. The checkpoint itself sits in the existing hicache host pool.

## Tests

Python:

- `test_flag_off_restores_original_ratios`, `test_flag_on_drops_base_but_keeps_no_buffer`, `test_host_only_drops_gpu_prefix_floor`: ratio is 3 / 4 / 5 with the flag off, and 1 / 2 / 3 with it on.
- `test_flag_off_keeps_a_donated_gpu_slot`, `test_host_only_no_buffer_frees_the_request_slot`.
- `test_kda_host_only_ring_follows_requests`: flag off charges every mamba slot; flag on charges `max_running_requests + 1` rows.
- `test_inflight_anchor_still_loads`: an anchor already in `ongoing_load_back` still load-backs. Moved out of the ratio file.
- `test_host_only_load_back_fills_request_slot_without_node_slot`, `test_host_only_second_load_back_on_inflight_anchor_retries`.

Rust (`sglang-radix-tree` mamba component):

- `missing_mamba_insert_keeps_the_existing_checkpoint_when_allowed`
- `insert_host_only_checkpoint_keeps_no_gpu_slot`
- `host_only_checkpoint_keeps_the_device_kv_prefix`
- `host_only_checkpoint_counts_gpu_kv_in_front_and_host_kv_at_the_boundary`
- `host_only_anchor_bumps_the_mamba_host_hit`
- `host_only_load_back_build_copies_into_the_request_slot_only`
- `host_only_load_back_commit_keeps_the_node_off_the_device_tier`
- `host_only_mamba_anchor_disables_branching_under_hicache`

On mi355, `test_mamba_donated_alloc_ratio.py` (18), `test_mamba_path_state_cap.py` (10), `test_replayssm_ring_accounting.py` (4), and `TestInflightAnchorStillLoads` passed. `cargo test --lib` for `sglang-radix-tree` passed 949 tests.

## Accuracy Tests

No model-output change when the variable is unset. With it set, load-back still restores the request slot from the host checkpoint; the GPU tests above cover that copy.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The memory table above is the measured effect. This PR does not include a new throughput number.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

## Motivation

Mamba radix checkpoints donate a GPU slot for every matched prefix. On a Kimi-K3 c=48 recipe that floor is `max_running_requests * 5` (480), so the GPU mamba pool stays large even when the checkpoint only needs to be reloaded from host.

## Modifications

Set `SGLANG_OPT_MAMBA_HOST_ONLY_CHECKPOINT=1` (default off). It requires `--enable-hierarchical-cache` and rejects `--enable-int8-mamba-checkpoint`. This is an environment variable, not a server argument.

With the variable unset, the server keeps the previous path: the same mamba ratio, the same donated GPU slot, the KDA ReplaySSM ring indexed by the mamba slot, a single in-flight load-back receipt, and a device match that follows GPU mamba slots. The new `InsertParams.allow_missing_mamba` bit stays false, so an insert that omits mamba still panics.

With the variable set:

- A finished request copies its flushed state into the hicache host pool and does not keep or donate a GPU slot.
- The mamba ratio drops to the live request plus the ping-pong tracking slots the extra-buffer kernel still writes. With extra buffer and overlap that is 3 (1 active + 2 ping-pong), so a 96-wide decode pool is 288 slots. `no_buffer` with page size 1 returns 1.
- The KDA ReplaySSM ring covers live requests (`max_running_requests // attn_dp + 1`) instead of every mamba slot. Padding rows are -1.
- The Rust insert accepts `mamba_host_value` without a donated `mamba_value`. A repeat insert that already found a checkpoint may omit both values; that permission is on the insert params and applies only to that insert.
- Under HiCache, a host checkpoint still counts as a device-prefix match, so the Full KV indices in front of it stay reachable. Load-back copies into the request slot and leaves the node on the host tier.

## Memory

Per-rank GPU, MI355, Kimi-K3 c=48, 96 running requests, page size 32, extra buffer, overlap, DCP 8, ReplaySSM on. The env-on pool is the size the ratio allows; `max-mamba-cache-size` has to be lowered with it. Leaving the pool at 480 keeps the 13 GB allocation and only raises the running-request cap.

| | Env off | Env on |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
